steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In June 2022, Equity Mates noted Perpetual offered active ETFs alongside other big names, highlighting that ETFs can now be actively managed rather than purely passive.

episode.title: The Pros and Cons of Passive ETFs vs. Active ETFs

views.text: In June 2022, Equity Mates introduced Perpetual’s Ethical Fund, a 20‑year strategy that floated on the ASX as GIVE, investing in Australian ethical and socially responsible companies.

episode.title: Expert: Nathan Hughes - The complexity of ESG & Three ASX stocks | Perpetual

views.text: In January 2022, Equity Mates explained Perpetual’s business as attracting funds to maximise management fees and building a team to outperform so it can earn performance fees, with a constant war for talent and clients.

episode.title: Inside the business of funds management - Perpetual Ltd w/ CEO Rob Adams | Summer Series

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In April 2022, Equity Mates argued Vanguard’s low‑cost index model built a moat through counter positioning, while active managers like Perpetual could not easily copy it without hurting their existing business models.

episode.title: Moats & Meme Stocks ft. return of Speccy Magee

views.text: In January 2022, Equity Mates described funds management as hotly contested, with about $2.5 trillion managed in Australia, over 300 competitors, and the top 10 controlling more than 50 percent, framing the challenge for Perpetual to maintain share.

episode.title: Inside the business of funds management - Perpetual Ltd w/ CEO Rob Adams | Summer Series

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In June 2022, a guest on Equity Mates explained Perpetual listed its long‑running ethical fund as GIVE on the ASX, keeping the same portfolio but a different fee structure to reach listed investors.

episode.title: Expert: Nathan Hughes - The complexity of ESG & Three ASX stocks | Perpetual

views.text: In January 2022, Equity Mates reported Perpetual was pushing a direct‑to‑retail strategy and embracing active ETFs, indicating investment in new distribution and products.

episode.title: Inside the business of funds management - Perpetual Ltd w/ CEO Rob Adams | Summer Series

views.text: In July 2020, a guest on Equity Mates said Perpetual had acquired sustainability manager Trillium, which aligned it with sustainable investing and supported its inclusion in an ESG fund’s portfolio.

episode.title: Expert Investor: Emilie O'Neill - The Research Process For ESG Investing
